name: dev.agentcaliper/registry-evidence
title: AgentCaliper Registry & Governance Evidence
description: Signed MCP Registry diffs & telemetry, stateless contract preflight, and SEP-2640 audit skills.

tools.name: check_dependency_changes
tools.description: Compare observed MCP Registry publication changes, declared runtime contract metadata, and opt-in publisher-signed baselines for one exact MCP Registry dependency since a baseline version or timestamp.

name.description: Exact qualified official MCP Registry name.

sinceVersion.description: Optional last known-good version to diff from.

sinceObservedAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp from a prior check.

tools.name: verify_contract_capture
tools.description: Deterministically inspect an MCP tools/list, SEP-2640 skills/list manifest, A2A Agent Card, or x402 HTTP 402 payment challenge in memory (zero storage). Optionally pass previousCapture to diff contract changes, readOnlyHint/destructiveHint privilege escalations, taskSupport shifts, skill SHA-256 drift, or x402 amount/recipient changes.

protocol.description: Protocol format of the supplied capture.

capture.description: Candidate capture JSON (or HTTP 402 header/Base64 for x402), up to 32 KiB.

previousCapture.description: Optional known-good baseline capture in the same protocol for release drift comparison.

tools.name: get_ecosystem_telemetry
tools.description: Return signed aggregate Official MCP Registry telemetry (tracked server counts, active/deprecated/deleted lifecycles, streamable-http vs sse adoption, declared required auth headers, and publisher-attested counts) compiled hourly without probing live endpoints.

tools.name: get_registry_listing_history
tools.description: Look up up to 24 observed versions, lifecycle statuses, declared transports, and contract metadata for one exact MCP Registry name. Use the official registry to confirm the current listing.

tools.name: get_registry_brief_preview
tools.description: Return the dated sample and coverage of the MCP Registry brief.

tools.name: get_registry_observation_receipt
tools.description: Return a signed receipt covering official MCP registry publication observations.

tools.name: get_product_catalog
tools.description: Return free resources, human kits, x402 machine products, and enabled payment modes.
